title: Three Special Friends
text: I have three special friends. Lily is very smart and curious. She asks many questions in class. Ben is active and funny. He loves to play games and make jokes. Ella is quiet and shy at first, but she is honest and patient with everyone. Sometimes Ben is a little naughty and lazy about homework, but he is still kind. I am happy to have friends like them!

questions.question: What is Lily like?
questions.source_sentence: Lily is very smart and curious.

questions.question: What is Ella like?
options: Quiet and shy, but honest and patient
questions.answer: Quiet and shy, but honest and patient
